family.description: The exact Forge research key supplied in the prompt; copy it verbatim.

identity.description: Checkpoint-scoped identity and license facts verified from primary sources.

upstreamName.description: The canonical upstream model or service name.

checkpoint.description: The exact checkpoint, model version, or NIM/service version; say not reported when absent.

revision.description: The immutable source/model revision when published; say not reported when absent.

parameterScale.description: Parameter count or other model scale exactly as reported; say not reported when absent.

architecture.description: The model architecture and task head at the scope covered by this dossier.

license.description: The exact model-weight and code license distinction; say not reported where necessary.

evidenceUrls.description: Primary-source URLs supporting the identity fields.

researchSummary.description: A concise checkpoint-scoped summary of supported uses and the most important evidence limits.

recommendedUseCases.description: Tasks directly supported for this exact checkpoint by primary evidence.

useCase.description: A concrete task for which this exact checkpoint is recommended.

why.description: The checkpoint-scoped evidence supporting the recommendation.

modelScope.description: The exact checkpoint, head, adapter, or serving mode to which the recommendation applies.

conditionalUseCases.description: Tasks appropriate only under explicit constraints or after downstream validation.

useCase.description: A concrete task that may be appropriate conditionally.

conditions.description: Required constraints, calibration, expert review, or downstream validation.

modelScope.description: The exact model scope covered by the conditional recommendation.

evidenceUrls.description: Primary-source URLs supporting the conditional recommendation.

avoidUseCases.description: Tasks for which the checkpoint should not be selected.

reason.description: The evidence-based limitation or explicit absence of validation.

modelScope.description: The model scope to which the exclusion applies.

evidenceUrls.description: Primary-source URLs supporting the exclusion; empty only when the stated reason is a documented evidence gap.

inputPreparation.description: Scientific/task-level input semantics and preparation, independent of the Forge transport envelope.

semanticInputs.description: The real-world entities or data types consumed by the model.

acceptedFormats.description: Officially accepted upstream formats and scope.

preprocessing.description: Ordered normalization, tokenization, resizing, featurization, or preprocessing requirements.

validation.description: Checks required before submission, including bounds and invalid or ambiguous cases.

taskSpecificFormatting.description: Official prompt templates, paired-input order, control fields, or task formatting.

outputInterpretation.description: Output objects, valid interpretation, and post-inference validation.

outputs.description: Objects emitted by the official model or implementation.

statement.description: One atomic output-contract claim, including shape, unit, or score semantics when known.

interpretation.description: How to interpret output values without overstating confidence or meaning.

validation.description: Post-inference quality, calibration, sanity, or downstream validation checks.

benchmarks.description: Checkpoint-matched public benchmark claims with enough protocol detail to prevent invalid comparisons.

dataset.description: The exact benchmark dataset or suite.

split.description: The exact split/subset; say not reported when the primary source omits it.

metric.description: The exact metric name and aggregation.

value.description: The reported value with units, uncertainty, or range when present.

direction.description: The metric direction; copy one enum value exactly.

modelScope.description: The exact checkpoint, scale, adapter, precision, task head, and evaluation mode covered by the claim.

conditions.description: Protocol details required for comparability, including prompting, retrieval, fine-tuning, ensemble, input shape, or leakage caveats.

sourceUrl.description: The primary source URL containing the benchmark claim.

sourceLocator.description: The exact table, figure, section, appendix, page, model-card heading, or repository path containing the claim.

caveats.description: Reasons this result may not be directly comparable to another.

comparisons.description: Task- and criterion-specific comparisons with named alternatives; no global winner claims.

alternative.description: The exact alternative model/checkpoint or family.

task.description: The task and setting for which the comparison applies.

verdict.description: The scoped selection result; copy one enum value exactly.

criteria.description: The decisive quality, cost, latency, modality, license, context, or operational criteria.

rationale.description: A scoped explanation grounded in comparable primary evidence.

comparisonConditions.description: The protocol conditions that match, differ, or prevent direct comparison.

evidenceUrls.description: Primary-source URLs supporting both sides of the comparison.

limitations.description: Scientific, data, architecture, evaluation, licensing, and operational limitations.

evidenceUrls.description: Primary-source URLs supporting the limitation; empty only for an explicitly labeled conservative policy guard.

safety.description: Model-specific privacy, biosecurity, clinical, dual-use, human-review, and data-handling requirements.

statement.description: One atomic safety or data-handling requirement; label conservative Forge policy when not stated upstream.

evidenceUrls.description: Primary-source URLs supporting the statement; empty only for a clearly labeled conservative Forge policy guard.

sources.description: The primary evidence set used by this dossier.

publisher.description: The model creator, official repository owner, original study authors, or standards body.

sourceType.description: The primary evidence type; copy one enum value exactly.

primary.description: True only for first-party documentation/repository/model card or an original research publication.

primaryReason.description: Why this publisher/source is primary for the specific claims it supports.

modelScope.description: The checkpoint, family, runtime, benchmark study, or implementation scope covered by the source.

supports.description: The specific dossier claims supported by this source.

evidenceGaps.description: Important unanswered questions, missing checkpoint results, incomparable benchmarks, or unvalidated runtime behavior.
